headline: U.S. Federal Reserve Raises Rates to 3.75%–4.00%, Signals More Tightening May Follow
seoTitle: U.S. Fed Raises Rates to 3.75%–4.00% | FMB News
seoDescription: The U.S. Federal Reserve raised its benchmark target range by 25 basis points to 3.75%–4.00% on September 16, its first increase in more than three years.
deck: The Federal Reserve unanimously raised its benchmark rate by a quarter percentage point as it said U.S. inflation remains elevated. The move matters beyond the United States because dollar interest rates influence currencies, borrowing costs and capital flows globally, including in the Philippines.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The U.S. Federal Open Market Committee raised the target range for the federal funds rate by 25 basis points to 3.75%–4.00% at its September 16 meeting. The decision was unanimous.
Reuters reported that this was the Federal Reserve's first interest-rate increase in more than three years and that policymakers flagged the possibility of additional tightening in coming months.
